title: Constant Rails
description: Constant Rails enhances Minecraft's minecart system by increasing cart speed and maintaining smooth, consistent travel across rail networks. Build longer railways, travel faster, and make minecarts a practical transportation option once again.
body: **Constant Rails** enhances Minecraft's minecart system by increasing cart speed and maintaining smooth, consistent travel across rail networks. Build longer railways, travel faster, and make minecarts a practical transportation option once again. Simple, lightweight, and designed to keep your rail journeys efficient.
